## Self-review checklist

- [ ] I read the full diff on GitHub
- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] New or changed logic has tests
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or personal data are included
- [ ] Logs never include issue text
- [ ] Published or history output still matches the data contract, or the contract was updated
- [ ] Documentation is updated (and PDFs regenerated if a document changed)
- [ ] A new ADR was added if this changes a significant decision
